title: 三运放仪表放大器
statement: 三运放仪表放大器（instrumentation amplifier）：u_1 = 1.0 V，u_2 = 1.2 V；第一级 Ra = Rb = 20 kΩ，Rg = 10 kΩ；第二级 R3 = R5 = 10 kΩ，Rf = R6 = 20 kΩ。运放均为理想运放。
求 Rg 中的电流 i_g（参考方向见图）、第一级输出 u_o1、u_o2 和最终输出 u_o。

questions.explain: 虚断：Ra、Rg、Rb 中是同一个电流 i_g。u_o1 = u_a + Ra·i_g = 1.0 + 20k × (−0.02 mA) = 0.6 V。
第二级是减法器（R6/R5 = Rf/R3 = 2）：u_o = 2(u_o2 − u_o1) = 2 V。总差模放大倍数 5 × 2 = 10。

hints: 先看第一级：A1、A2 的虚短把 u_1、u_2 直接“搬”到 Rg 两端。
A1、A2 的反相端不取电流，所以 Ra、Rg、Rb 串联、电流相同；第二级是熟悉的减法器。
solution: **1. 虚短：** u_a = u_1 = 1.0 V，u_b = u_2 = 1.2 V，Rg 两端电压就是输入差 u_1 − u_2 = −0.2 V。
**2. 虚断：** i_g = (u_a − u_b)/Rg = **−0.02 mA**，这个电流同样流过 Ra（o1 → a）和 Rb（b → o2）。
**总结：** u_o = (Rf/R3)(1 + 2Ra/Rg)(u_2 − u_1) = 10 × 0.2 = 2 V。两个输入都接同相端，输入电阻为无穷大；只需改变一个电阻 Rg 就能调节放大倍数。

en.title: Three-op-amp instrumentation amplifier
statement: A three-op-amp instrumentation amplifier: v_1 = 1.0 V, v_2 = 1.2 V; first stage Ra = Rb = 20 kΩ, Rg = 10 kΩ; second stage R3 = R5 = 10 kΩ, Rf = R6 = 20 kΩ. All op-amps are ideal.
Find the current i_g in Rg (reference as drawn), the first-stage outputs v_o1 and v_o2, and the final output v_o.

questions.explain: Virtual short: v_a = v_1 = 1.0 V, v_b = v_2 = 1.2 V. i_g = (v_a − v_b)/Rg = −0.2/10k = −0.02 mA.
Virtual open: Ra, Rg and Rb carry the same current i_g. v_o1 = v_a + Ra·i_g = 1.0 + 20k × (−0.02 mA) = 0.6 V.
v_o2 = v_b − Rb·i_g = 1.2 + 0.4 = 1.6 V. The differential voltage is amplified by (1 + 2Ra/Rg) = 5: v_o2 − v_o1 = 5 × 0.2 = 1.0 V.
The second stage is a subtractor (R6/R5 = Rf/R3 = 2): v_o = 2(v_o2 − v_o1) = 2 V. Overall differential gain 5 × 2 = 10.

hints: Start with the first stage: the virtual shorts of A1 and A2 copy v_1 and v_2 straight onto the two ends of Rg.
The inverting inputs of A1 and A2 draw no current, so Ra, Rg and Rb are in series with the same current; the second stage is the familiar subtractor.
solution: **1. Virtual short:** v_a = v_1 = 1.0 V, v_b = v_2 = 1.2 V, so the voltage across Rg is the input difference v_1 − v_2 = −0.2 V.
**2. Virtual open:** i_g = (v_a − v_b)/Rg = **−0.02 mA**, and the same current flows through Ra (o1 → a) and Rb (b → o2).
**3. First-stage outputs:** v_o1 = v_a + Ra·i_g = **0.6 V**, v_o2 = v_b − Rb·i_g = **1.6 V**.
v_o2 − v_o1 = (1 + 2Ra/Rg)(v_2 − v_1) = 5 × 0.2 = 1.0 V, while the common-mode part (v_o1 + v_o2)/2 = 1.1 V = (v_1 + v_2)/2 is not amplified.
**Summary:** v_o = (Rf/R3)(1 + 2Ra/Rg)(v_2 − v_1) = 10 × 0.2 = 2 V. Both inputs go to non-inverting inputs, so the input resistance is infinite, and the gain is set by the single resistor Rg.
